channel.title: The Hollywood Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hollywood Reporter (hollywoodreporter.com)

item.title: ‘Copshop’ Writer Settles Lawsuit Against Managers Over Conflict of Interest on Pay
item.description: Kurt McLeod accused his managers, who produced the movie he wrote, of prioritizing their compensation by failing to disclose a substantial increase to the film's budget.

item.title: Hilary Duff Heads to L.A.: How to Secure Sold-Out Concert Tickets
item.description: The Small Rooms, Big Nerves mini tour marks her first in 18 years. Here's how fans can still snag seats — and at a discount — with THR-exclusive promo codes.

item.title: Ray J Says He Only Has Months to Live Following Hospitalization: “2027 Is Definitely a Wrap for Me”
item.description: The singer was recently hospitalized for pneumonia.

item.title: Leonard Kornberg, Longtime Studio Executive and Story Analyst, Dies at 75
item.description: He worked on 'Paddington,' 'The Mummy,' 'King Kong,' 'Hacksaw Ridge' and 'Psycho,' among other projects.

item.title: Why Kristen Stewart Says She’ll Probably Leave America: “I Can’t Work Freely”
item.description: The actress and director currently lives in Los Angeles and New York with her wife, Dylan Meyer.

item.title: ‘Give Me the Ball!’ Review: Rousing Bio-Doc Pays Tribute to the Indomitable Billie Jean King, Whose Tenacity Equalized the Professional Tennis Court
item.description: ESPN’s ‘30 for 30’ series entry, directed by Liz Garbus and Elizabeth Wolff, is a lovingly made account of the life and career of a galvanizing force in sports, women’s rights and LGBTQ visibility.

item.title: “Long Live Women in Music”: Chappell Roan, Chaka Khan, Joni Mitchell and More Gather for Resonator Awards
item.description: The star-studded event, put on by the organization We Are Moving the Needle, kicked off Grammy Week by gathering attendees for a celebration of women working in the music industry.

item.title: Odessa A’zion Pulls Out of A24 Film ‘Deep Cuts’ After Casting Backlash: “I Hadn’t Read the Book”
item.description: The ‘Marty Supreme’ and ‘I Love LA’ star has apologized to fans of the book and revealed that she voluntarily backed out of the film, which is supposed to start shooting in February.
